ts_tol: LeRobot tolerance_s default (1e-4 s); known to false-alarm on float32 rounding and miss near-miss frames (lerobot issue 5187)
vid_tol_frames: 2 frames of slack between video metadata and parquet rows
vel_limit: 2 x p99.9 of |velocity| per joint on the calibration episodes; fail above 2x that limit
range: observed min/max per joint widened by 25% of the observed span
stuck: zero variance over 60 frames while another joint moves more than 15 degrees
grip_min_range: 25% of the smallest per-episode gripper range
lag: median best action->state lag on calibration episodes, tolerance +-2 frames
length: 0.7 x shortest to 1.5 x longest calibration episode
idle: 1.25 x highest idle fraction on calibration episodes

checks.detail: joint constant for 60+ frames while others move
checks.name: stuck joint
